revision_note: Revision 5, committed ALONE before holdout-v9 candidate construction (strict pre-registration order; the v9 candidate lands only in a later commit) and after the v8 acceptance audit (2026-10-12). v8 is retained as a consumed successful E2E safety run but not the closing gate: it produced no contract-complete record (claims rows all versionless with empty models), its labels allowed any main outcome with zero floors, and revision 4a had been committed in the same commit as the v8 candidate. Revision 5 changes: (1) the extraction prompt is bumped to phase6-impact-extraction-v2 — when the official evidence states version bounds in machine-readable form (structured fields such as versionStartIncluding/versionEndExcluding, or explicit comparators), the model expresses the range with the closed grammar; prose-only evidence is quoted verbatim; absent versions stay null; models lists concrete identities the evidence states below the product family; (2) the stale-version grounding detector now requires every version boundary of a supported range to appear in the cited evidence (whole-expression matching cannot work for closed-grammar expressions derived from structured fields); (3) new per-case label constraints, asserted per case and folded into the gate: claims_rows_max (ceiling on auto-claims rows, for the unsupported-format demonstration), models_min (minimum distinct evidence-backed models across claims rows, for record completeness), claims_require_versions (every claims row must carry a supported affected range AND a non-null supported fixed version — the contract-complete record requirement), and forbidden_strings (strings that must never surface in any persisted row or review payload — the explicit stale-version prohibition). Revision 4, committed before holdout-v7 construction and after the v6 holdout was consumed with a defective scorer (audit findings, 2026-10-11). The v6 run's four uninitialized safety counters, window-based receipt matching, three-field Story check, N/A-as-1 recall scoring, and absent scorer did not constitute a gate; v6 stays frozen as evidence and is NOT the Phase 6 end-to-end gate. Revision 4 changes: (1) the end-to-end runner computes all thirteen hard safety counters with real assertions — unsupported_claim (a current claims row carrying a real version expression the deterministic matcher cannot parse), stale_version_commits (a supported range whose raw expression appears in none of its cited evidence), cross_story_evidence (persisted rows citing evidence not stored Story-local), absence_unaffected (unaffected language in persisted exploit status or mitigations), gateway_bypass (a propose outcome without an exactly-receipted gateway call, or an unaccounted llm receipt on the Story), kev_yes_without_evidence, low_confidence_claim, forbidden_row (claims rows citing non-allowlisted evidence sources), receipt_or_trace_incomplete (extraction receipt must match run id, purpose impact-extraction, Story subject, completed status; tool receipts must exist and be completed), routing_inconsistent, poc_not_unknown, duplicate_commits, story_fact_mutations (full Story row + Facts + Story-Fact article links snapshot compare); (2) row recall is scored only for runs that decided to propose and persisted at least one current row — outcomes that propose nothing or route every row to human review are excluded from the denominator, never scored as hits; (3) normalization semantics revision: a matcher-unsupported version expression on an otherwise-high draft routes the draft to human review with an explicit unknown instead of persisting a claims row — the offline normalization fixture holdout (23 cases) retains its pre-revision-4 frozen expectations as consumed evidence only and is not re-runnable as a gate without a newly constructed fixture holdout; (4) the runner now ends with a fail-closed scorer that reads this file, requires every listed metric to be present, and exits non-zero on any failure; (5) revision-4a, committed before holdout-v8 construction after the v7 consumption: the gate additionally fails on ANY per-case assertion error (frozen floors such as min_rows and human_reviews_min, decision membership, and every other per-case check) — aggregate metrics staying above threshold no longer mask a per-case violation, which the v7 run's post-audit showed was still possible.
applies_to: Phase 6 end-to-end holdout v2 on real public evidence (evaluation correction)
freeze_rule: Committed before holdout-v2 construction. The end-to-end holdout v2 must use real public CVE evidence disjoint from both development datasets and from the consumed first holdout; the complete TypeScript -> Python -> TypeScript -> scratch-database pipeline runs exactly once against it, including receipt, trace, Story/Fact immutability, stale-version, and idempotency checks. A failed or consumed holdout stays immutable; remediation requires a new disjoint holdout. The synthetic normalization fixture holdout (23 cases) and the failed first end-to-end holdout (3 cases) are retained as evidence only and are not gates. REVISION 3 NOTE (before holdout-v6 construction): row_recall applies only to runs that decided to propose; an insufficient_evidence outcome is scored by unknown_honesty alone, because a grounded-row expectation cannot be part of an outcome set that also allows insufficient_evidence. The v5 holdout (SHA256 520f791c...) was consumed under revision 2 and its below-gate row_recall (0.67) is retained as evidence, not re-scored. REVISION 4 NOTE (before holdout-v7 construction): the Phase 6 end-to-end gate is the first holdout run under the revision-4 runner and scorer — v7, real public evidence disjoint from every development dataset and every consumed holdout v1-v6, run exactly once, gated only by this file's hard safety maximums and quality minimums as computed by the revision-4 runner. The v6 holdout (SHA256 3d8f8038...) was consumed under the revision-3 runner whose scorer was defective (uninitialized counters, window-based receipt matching, partial Story checks, N/A-as-1 recall, no threshold adjudication); it stays frozen and is retained as a live smoke/pilot result, not as the gate. REVISION 5 NOTE (before holdout-v9 construction): the Phase 6 closing gate is the single authorized v9 run under the revision-5 runner; v8 (SHA256 cbe235f6...) stays frozen as a consumed successful E2E safety run and is not the closing gate because it demonstrated no contract-complete record and its labels carried zero floors. At least one v9 case MUST hard-require decision=propose with min_rows>=1 and evidence-backed models plus matcher-supported affected and fixed versions on every claims row; the unsupported-format case MUST hard-require human_reviews_min>=1 with zero claims rows; the stale case MUST name explicit forbidden strings checked against persisted state and review payloads.
